reviews.title: Best app for genuine connections
reviews.text: we are humans and looks play a big part in determining who we talk too. so when i realize this particular app has no bulk messaging or overly pushing pay to participate features thats when i knew the difference between genuine attempts at connection versus trying to get the most notifications or the most responses/complements . i am glad that whipd is not like other apps that make it nearly impossible to communicate with user and get a wider reach for real communication with users. this app has a point systems that actually works. you get about 20 adds per day however you are able to buy more or earn more. with that there is movement. its up to the user to tell the app and others that they actually want to be socials. it allows more ease of mind knowing thats its not spam or someone who’s just going to not answer. my only critique is the app freezes and the user interface is not well explained when first downloaded. i had to learn most of the features by myself, however thats not hard for me but it maybe for those who don’t have good context clue skills. i hope the developers see my review and don’t change a thing i love the user interface and design choices like the theme of the app. i also love the protection this app has and moderation although i think users should be able to appeal if banned or maybe giving warning or consider timed bans bc unfortunately some of us cannot help that our clothes show off more cleavage/skin than others 😅 but i understand its for the safety of the user and developer /stakeholders i just didnt think my regular shirt was too v/necked thank you for reading find me on whipd
